thread:
Sam (Sales): Hey team — Acme POC hit repeated 429s on embeddings yesterday. Demo tomorrow morning, customer blocked. Can we triage?
Maya (SE): Got logs from their test tenant acme-001. Pattern: lots of tiny embed calls (payloads ~50 tokens) in parallel, then 429s for a minute.
Maya (SE): Sample response headers show: `x-rate-limit-remaining: 0`, `x-rate-limit-reset: 22`, and `x-burst-window-remaining: 0`.
Chris (SRE): Do we have the exact route? `/v1/embeddings`? Is it per-tenant global cap or per-route?
Maya (SE): Yes, `/v1/embeddings` route. Looks like per-route cap + a short burst window (token-bucket style). The small requests burn the burst quickly.
Julien (Eng): Confirmed — short, high-concurrency calls skew the token accounting. We prioritize latency SLO so burst window is small to protect shared capacity.
Sam (Sales): Customer asks for a short-term lift for the demo. How fast can we do that and what happens to billing?
Tara (Acct Exec): If we do a temporary bump it's a metered usage increase; will show on their invoice. We can offer a one-hour trial bump free for the demo if CS approves.
Chris (SRE): I can apply a temporary per-tenant burst increase for acme-001 for 60 minutes. Need approval from product on limits.
Julien (Eng): Suggest two mitigations: 1) temporary burst bump (low risk) 2) recommend batching their embedding calls (merge small payloads) which reduces token accounting overhead.
Maya (SE): Also flagged that they aren't sending `X-Redwood-Request-Group` header. If used, our routing will coalesce parallel calls from same group into fewer batches. Ask customer to add header to client.
Sam (Sales): Ok will ask them to add header. Chris — please apply the 60m bump now, we need green for 9am PST.
quota-bot: applied temporary_burst_bump tenant=acme-001 duration=3600 issuer=chris.sre scope=/v1/embeddings new_burst=+15000
Chris (SRE): Done. Bump applied. I also lowered their per-route concurrency cap from 200 -> 120 to smooth spikes.
Maya (SE): Re-ran their test script after bump, no 429s for 10k quick embeds. :thumbsup:
Tara (Acct Exec): I'll document the one-time courtesy bump in the deal notes and flag billing.
Julien (Eng): For longer term: propose changing token-bucket window to 10s for POCs and a ruleset that auto-suggests batching for embeddings-heavy tenants. I'll draft a config change RFC.
Sam (Sales): Perfect. Two follow-ups for us: (1) ask customer to add header and batch where possible, (2) confirm demo success and we can remove bump.
Maya (SE): I'll send the header + sample client snippet to Acme. Example snippet:```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
     -H "X-Redwood-Request-Group: acme-demo-1" \
     -d '{"input": ["short text 1","short text 2"]}' \
     https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
```
Chris (SRE): Note: if they keep the high parallelism we'll recommend a Dedicated pool for predictable throughput — we should loop in account team.
Tara (Acct Exec): On it. I'll follow up after the demo.
Sam (Sales): Thanks everyone. Closing this thread after demo confirmation.
